The `mathR` provides convenience functions for some basic algrebraic tasks. To install this package from GitHub, use

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# install.packages("remotes")
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("ADC-405-S26/mathR")
```

Load the package using the following code.

```{r setup}
library(mathR)
```

The package contains three functions

* `root_finding`

* `line_line_intersection`
* `modular_arithmetic_for_function`
